answer.rationale: Use activation messaging to reinforce value and accelerate meaningful product use among at-risk SMB accounts. Its archived source showed activation +6% and 30-day retention +1%. Reject a broad pricing response despite acquisition lift: the verified discount experiment raised qualified revenue 18% but reduced 30-day retention 12%, conflicting with sustainable long-term qualified revenue. Keep this as a measured experiment because the messaging evidence is positive but not specific to competitor-driven churn or retention beyond 30 days.
